sources.title: Tryndamere Build Guide: Step1v9 Tryndamere Guide
Tryndamere Build Guides, Runes, Items, and Abilities - Patch 26.19

passive.name: Battle Fury
passive.text: Tryndamere gains Fury for each attack, critical strike, and killing blow he makes. Fury passively increases his Critical Strike Chance and can be consumed with his Bloodlust spell.

spells.name: Bloodlust
spells.text: Tryndamere thrives on the thrills of combat, increasing his Attack Damage as he is more and more wounded. He can cast Bloodlust to consume his Fury and heal himself.

spells.name: Mocking Shout
spells.text: Tryndamere lets out an insulting cry, decreasing surrounding champions' Attack Damage. Enemies with their backs turned to Tryndamere also have their Move Speed reduced.

spells.name: Spinning Slash
spells.text: Tryndamere slices toward a target unit, dealing damage to enemies in his path.

spells.name: Undying Rage
spells.text: Tryndamere's lust for battle becomes so strong that he is unable to die, no matter how wounded he becomes.

archetype.value: Tryndamere is a bruiser who builds Fury through combat, heals himself, and can become unable to die.

axis.value: Tryndamere looks for auto-attack all-ins rather than poke.

spikes.why: Tryndamere gains Critical Strike Chance and can consume that Fury to heal.

mistakes.value: Tryndamere players risk a gank when they look for an all-in without tracking the enemy jungler.
Tryndamere gives up Fury’s Critical Strike Chance when he consumes it with Bloodlust, so spending it without needing the heal is a mistake.
